title: Coded Interview
description: Container for a single coded interview. Stored in `.system/coded/<name>.json`.

interview_id.description: Interview name, usually the same as the transcript file name without extension.

recorded_at.description: ISO date the interview was conducted, YYYY-MM-DD.

language.description: Interview language. mixed — when two languages are interleaved.

duration_seconds.description: Duration of the source recording in seconds.

respondent_meta.description: Aggregated demographics for context. Respondent PII (name, phone, email) is never recorded here.

demographic_label.description: A free-form label, for example 'female, 34, large city'.

coded_by.description: Who did the coding. 'agent' — the current assistant. 'external:transcript-coding' — an external skill. 'human:<name>' — manual coding.

model.description: Model used for coding (when agent or external). For example 'claude-opus-4-7' or 'gpt-5-4'.

subagent_strategy.description: Whether subagents were used. none — a single pass. parallel-chunks — batched parallel coding of chunks with manager validation.

schema_version.description: Segment schema version. When the schema is upgraded this field changes, and downstream skills check it.

verbatim_check.description: Result of verbatim validation of quotes against the source transcript.
